MANUFACTURE LIKE A PRO ™

We're your single resource from prototyping to production. Partner with Protolabs to accelerate product development and get to market faster than ever before. When you're ready for production, get complete program management with a team of manufacturing experts who will help optimize your project around cost, quantity, and quality.
How to Work With Us
To start, simply select a manufacturing process and upload a 3D CAD file.
Within a few hours we'll send you design for manufacturability (DFM) analysis and real-time pricing.
Once you review your quote and place your order, we'll start the manufacturing process. We also offer finishing options.
Our digital manufacturing process allows us to produce parts in as fast as 1 day.

We offer both automated and live manufacturing support. With every quote, you get free interactive manufacturability analysis to quickly improve part design, but if you have additional questions, applications engineers are always available to talk through your project at 877-479-3680 or [email protected] .
Digital Manufacturing Across Your Product Life Cycle
Whether you need prototype parts in one day or full-service production, you can partner with us across your entire product life cycle for speed, quality, and cost-efficiency in every project.
Take advantage of DFM feedback in our instant quotes to make adjustments to part design before any actual manufacturing begins, then navigate quickly through prototyping with ease.
You’ll find complete program management at Protolabs with a team of manufacturing experts who will help optimize your project around cost, quantity, and quality.
Tap into our production capabilities for short-term needs like jigs, fixtures, and industrial components, or managing inventory and financial costs towards the end of the product life cycle.
We work with more than 90% of Fortune 100 companies from our target industries.
High-quality components from early prototyping to hot-fire testing to launch
Rapid prototyping and ramp-up production for traditional, electric, and autonomous vehicles
Functional prototyping and on-demand production of consumer and computer electronics parts
Accelerated development of medical devices and health care products
Choose from hundreds of commercial-grade plastic, metal, elastomer, and liquid silicone rubber materials suitable for both prototyping and production.

Get in-depth design advice to optimise your plastic and metal parts for CNC machining. Designing with machinng in mind can accelerate production time and reduce production costs.

raw_blocks: What is Protolabs Network? | Learn More arrow_right_alt
Advancing Global Innovation Through Digital Manufacturing

Hello! Welcome to the digital manufacturing revolution. Protolabs is the world’s fastest manufacturing service enabling companies across every industry to streamline production of quality parts throughout the entire product life cycle. Founded in 1999, we radically reduced the time needed to produce molded prototypes through complex software that automated the manufacturing process. Over the next two decades, we added CNC machining, 3D printing, and sheet metal fabrication, and later launched Protolabs Network , our global network of manufacturing partners. Our 25+ years of growth and expanding capabilities provide customers with the best digital manufacturing experience in the industry.
We shape the future by bringing customer ideas to life across every stage of the product life cycle.
Accelerating innovation by revolutionizing manufacturing.
Global Manufacturing for Regional Onshoring
Our digital factories produce low-volume parts in days while our digital network of manufacturing partners unlocks advanced capabilities and volume pricing at higher quantities.

We’re here from start to finish to support you throughout your manufacturing journey. From custom prototyping to end-use production and every phase in-between, we're your trusted manufacturing partner helping you drive product development and innovation forward.

Optimize part design and accelerate iterative development with our rapid prototyping and low-volume production services. Benefit from automated online quoting, real-time pricing with design for manufacturability (DFM) feedback, and quality parts delivered in as fast as a day.

Partner with our support team to gain improved cost-efficiencies with lower piece-part prices as volumes increase, benefit from quality certifications like ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AS9100D, and access advanced capabilities for tighter tolerances, larger part sizes, enhanced finishes, and more.
Giving Back to the Community

We love giving back to the community and pride ourselves in being a responsible corporate citizen through the Protolabs Foundation, whose efforts are a sustaining investment in the future of the communities where our employees live and work, such as grants to fund local STEM-based projects in K-12 schools.

Protolabs is built around our most valuable asset—our employees. We've purposefully cultivated a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and appreciated. Our company values reflect who we are as a company and to each other. Interested? We’re seeking dynamic, smart, and creative individuals to help us grow and shape the future manufacturing.
Chief Technology & AI Officer
Vice President of Sales & Customer Service, Americas
Vice President of Sales & Customer Service, Europe

raw_blocks: ProDesk: An AI-enabled Resource to Accelerate Innovation
ProDesk simplifies the entire manufacturing process with seamless collaboration, AI-driven manufacturability analysis, real-time pricing, and more

ProDesk is your go-to digital manufacturing resource to accelerate prototype and production projects from start to finish. The intuitive platform elevates the tasks you do most: get quotes fast, reorder with ease, connect with production experts, access recent activity, and stay up to date on the latest platform enhancements. Simply put: ProDesk is your smarter home for more efficient work.
A Comprehensive Platform from Prototyping to Production
Select materials, secondary operations, and finishing options, and ProDesk automatically calculates the final price and generates an accurate quote in real time.
Keep your team aligned from order to delivery by collaborating on active and past orders, so nothing gets missed when roles shift.
Lead times are configured within the quoting process, allowing users to select depending on turn-time needs and budget. Once a lead time is chosen, the quote will be updated instantly.
Get instant, AI-driven feedback on your CAD model to improve part quality and accelerate production. ProDesk flags risks with interactive 3D visuals, allowing you to optimize manufacturability early.
Transition from prototyping to production by organizing and reordering production-ready parts in one place. Flag parts to add to the Production Catalog so team members can quickly reorder.
Get help with orders, documents, changes, billing, and quality in one centralized hub. Submit a request, call, chat, or email. Design Guides are also available for each service line.

ProDesk helps you move faster with seamless navigation, configurable quotes, robust DFM analysis, and easy collaboration across teams, plus direct access to ordering support and engineering expertise.
ProDesk streamlines production ordering with simplified navigation, a Production Catalog for easy reordering, built-in collaboration, and a Support Center for quality documents and customer support.
Explore Sample Quotes by Service

Our sample quotes let you test drive our digital manufacturing platform. See how pricing updates in real time as you adjust materials, quantity, and lead times. Explore interactive design analysis on different features with our AI-enabled DFM feedback. Each service line has unique considerations, so try them all out.
Look for the in-depth moldability analysis and our prototyping vs. ODM pricing comparison feature.
See how easy it is to assign threads to holes and check out some of the machining advisories you may encounter.
Explore our material feature that lets you compare the cost of 3DP processes, materials, and resolutions.
Get in-depth design advice to optimize your plastic parts for injection molding. Designing with moldability in mind can accelerate production time and reduce production costs.
Digital Manufacturing from Prototyping to Production

We’re here from start to finish to support you throughout your manufacturing journey. From custom prototyping to end-use production and every phase in-between—we are your trusted manufacturing partner helping you drive product development and innovation forward. Now that’s progress!

We are your manufacturing partner to scale projects to production. Get complete program management with a team who can tailor our capabilities to optimize cost, quantity, and quality control of your production order.
